persistent_data.evidence: SQLite database of users, versioned answers and rules, settings and failed lookups (migrations/001_init.sql:1-21, migrations/002_failed_lookups.sql:1-9, desk/app.py:16).

schema_changes.evidence: Versioned SQL migrations applied by deskctl.py migrate (deskctl.py:12-21, migrations/001-002), run at container start (Dockerfile:6).

multi_tenant.evidence: 'One company runs one Rules Desk' (README.md:3); no organisation column in any table (migrations/001_init.sql).

hosted_service.evidence: Long-lived Flask service under gunicorn answering the help widget (Dockerfile:6, desk/app.py:39-45).

machine_actions.evidence: A token-authenticated JSON API changes definitions and settings: PUT /admin/<kind>s/<key>, POST .../undo, PUT /admin/settings/<name> with X-Desk-Token (desk/app.py:28-36,64-112); any script holding a lead token can call it.

agent_mutations.evidence: No AI or agents in the product; 'smart matching' is keyword overlap and regex (desk/matching.py:1-23).

evolution_auto_apply.evidence: No evolution loop; lead edits go live on save, but they are made by people (desk/app.py:64-70).

definition_change_path.evidence: Leads change answers, routing rules and settings through /admin with no deploy (desk/app.py:53-112, desk/templates/admin.html:1-32, README.md:7-11).

code_release_path.evidence: No evolution system or AI produces code; new queues and widget changes are hand-made engineering releases (README.md:12-13, config/queues.yaml:1). Ordinary engineering releases are not an evolution-system code path.

ai_features.evidence: No model calls: matching is keyword counting and regex (desk/matching.py:12-23); requirements.txt:1-2 list flask and PyYAML only. README.md:21 'smart matching' is not ML.

change_kinds.name: Add or edit an answer the widget gives
change_kinds.evidence: PUT /admin/answers/<key> checked by desk/checks.py:20-30, saved as a version with author (desk/store.py:19-25), history and undo (desk/app.py:73-85, desk/store.py:34-38, tests/test_versions.py:4-9); admin page buttons (desk/templates/admin.html:11-12). Gap: undo refuses when only one version exists (desk/store.py:36-37) and there is no delete, so a brand-new answer can be corrected but not withdrawn. docs/change-requests.md:7: 112 requests.

change_kinds.name: Add or change a routing rule
change_kinds.evidence: PUT /admin/rules/<key> checked by desk/checks.py:33-45 (tests/test_checks.py), versioned with undo (desk/store.py:19-38); same first-version undo gap (desk/store.py:36-37). docs/change-requests.md:8: 41 requests.

change_kinds.name: Greeting and opening hours
change_kinds.evidence: PUT /admin/settings/<name> overwrites with INSERT OR REPLACE (desk/app.py:105-112); no version, history or undo, despite README.md:15 'Every admin change can be undone'. Supported path without undo is reach 0. docs/change-requests.md:9: 6 requests.

change_kinds.name: Add a support queue
change_kinds.evidence: config/queues.yaml:1-6 edited by engineers and released (README.md:12, docs/change-requests.md:10).

change_kinds.name: Widget look and text
change_kinds.evidence: Front-end code and a release (README.md:13, docs/change-requests.md:11); not in this repository.

request.evidence: docs/change-requests.md:5-9: July to September 2026, 112 answer and 41 rule changes made by support leads on the admin page, with no release (a first-party summary counted from the request inbox, not raw version records).
request.note: Summary document, not the definition_versions table itself.

fix.searched: README.md:23-25 describes a weekly failed-lookup review, but no records of fixes made from failed lookups are in the repository (docs/, tests/).

expansion.searched: README.md, docs/change-requests.md; no records of new capabilities launched.

ai_delivery.evidence: Searched the repo/ folder: no agent instruction files, no agent workflows; .github/workflows/ci.yml:1-16 runs pytest and pip-audit only.

ARC-01.evidence: Hand-written SQL per feature on SQLite (desk/store.py:11-51); UNIQUE (kind, key, version) index (migrations/001_init.sql:17) and failed_lookups_area index (migrations/002_failed_lookups.sql:9); no caching, all_current re-queried per /ask (desk/app.py:42-45).

ARC-02.evidence: Versioned forward-only migration files applied by deskctl.py migrate (deskctl.py:12-21); no down steps or online strategy.

ARC-03.evidence: State in a SQLite file on local disk (desk/app.py:16, README.md:34); one container. No shared store, no scale-out guidance.

ARC-04.evidence: No queue or background work; everything, including failed-lookup writes, runs in the request (desk/app.py:39-45).

ARC-05.rationale: multi_tenant is false: one company per deployment (README.md:3).

ARC-06.evidence: No load tests or documented limits (tests/ are functional; README.md has none).

ARC-07.evidence: /health returns status and version (desk/app.py:115-117); no monitor, metrics or objectives in scope.
ARC-07.alt_note: The health endpoint is ready for an uptime check, though none is configured in scope.

ARC-08.evidence: No outbound dependencies besides local SQLite and the queues file (desk/checks.py:9-11); errors surface per request via Flask defaults; no timeouts or isolation policy.

ARC-09.evidence: deskctl.py backup copies the whole SQLite DB, which holds data, definitions, settings and user tokens (deskctl.py:24-32); no restore command; tests/test_backup.py:6-8 only checks the file is non-empty, so README.md:38 'Backups are tested in CI' does not mean restore is tested.

DEL-01.evidence: Change requests arrive by email outside the product (docs/change-requests.md:3); no request object.

DEL-02.evidence: One image (Dockerfile:1-6); no build or deploy automation in the repository (ci.yml only tests).
DEL-02.alt_note: Releases are numbered (desk/app.py:9, docs/change-requests.md:10) and may be built automatically outside the repository.

DEL-03.evidence: Package split by convention (desk/app.py, store.py, checks.py, matching.py); no enforced boundaries.

DEL-04.evidence: No AI implementation lane; leads and engineers make every change by hand.

DEL-05.evidence: CI on every PR and push runs pytest and pip-audit (.github/workflows/ci.yml:2-16); answer and rule saves pass desk/checks.py before landing (desk/app.py:67-69); settings saves are unchecked (desk/app.py:105-112) and queues.yaml changes have no validation test.

DEL-06.evidence: /health returns status and version (desk/app.py:115-117); no config snapshot.

DEL-07.evidence: Documented manual local setup (README.md:29-32); no scripted or per-change instances.
DEL-07.alt_note: The image migrates and starts itself from a build (Dockerfile:6), close to a scripted instance.

DEL-08.evidence: Unit tests only (tests/test_checks.py, test_versions.py, test_backup.py); no journeys.

DEL-09.evidence: A saved answer or rule is live for every widget user at once (desk/templates/admin.html:5, desk/app.py:64-70); no flags or cohorts.

DEL-10.evidence: No runtime switch to turn a change off; undo creates a new version (desk/store.py:34-38) and settings have none.

DEL-11.rationale: code_release_path is false: no evolution system or AI ships code.

MAL-01.rationale: focused-application: Rules Desk answers help-widget questions and routes the rest (README.md:3).

MAL-02.evidence: Answer and rule bodies have fixed fields validated in code (desk/checks.py:20-45); adding a field is code.

MAL-06.evidence: Endpoints described only in README.md:9-25; structured 422 error lists (desk/app.py:68-69) but no introspection or OpenAPI.

MAL-07.evidence: Admin page and widget layout are code (desk/templates/admin.html; README.md:13 widget changes need a release).

MAL-08.rationale: focused-application: Rules Desk answers help-widget questions and routes the rest (README.md:3).

MAL-09.evidence: Greeting and opening hours are stored text the lead edits (desk/app.py:10,105-112, desk/app.py:48-50 serves them); widget look and other text are code (README.md:13); no tokens or locales.

MAL-10.evidence: Routing rules are declarative (pattern, queue, priority) evaluated by desk/matching.py:19-23, composed by leads; narrow scope (question to queue only); a try endpoint exists only in the API (desk/app.py:88-96), not on the admin page.
MAL-10.alt_note: Leads compose rules through a supported path with a test mode (POST /admin/rules/try).

MAL-12.evidence: No hook points; custom logic is core code.

MAL-13.evidence: No plugin points; extension is editing the repository.

MAL-14.evidence: No plugin runtime or isolation; all code runs with full trust.

MAL-15.evidence: No extension developer loop; product developers follow README.md:27-32.

MAL-17.evidence: Queue inboxes are wired by engineers in config and at release time (config/queues.yaml:1-6).

MAL-18.evidence: Admin API undocumented beyond README.md table; no versioning (routes at desk/app.py:58-112).

MAL-19.evidence: Only README prose about the admin endpoints; no typed tool surface or capability map.

MAL-20.evidence: No conversational surface; the widget is keyword lookup (desk/matching.py:12-16).

LRN-01.evidence: No usage telemetry beyond failed-lookup rows, which no platform feature consumes (desk/store.py:41-51).
LRN-01.alt_note: Failed lookups are queryable structured records as soon as they happen.

LRN-02.evidence: Failed lookups are typed signals (question, normalised, area, channel; migrations/002_failed_lookups.sql:1-8) but not linked to any definition or version.

LRN-03.evidence: Each unanswered question is stored with area and channel (desk/app.py:43-44, desk/store.py:41-44) and queryable by area (desk/app.py:99-102, desk/store.py:47-51, tests/test_versions.py:12-15). No friction detection or issue objects.

LRN-04.evidence: No joined sources; request counting is done outside the product (docs/change-requests.md:3).

LRN-05.evidence: Leads read a raw list of failed questions (desk/store.py:47-51); no grouping or context.

LRN-06.evidence: A failed-lookup list by area is the only report (desk/app.py:99-102); no recommendations.

LRN-07.evidence: Leads review failed lookups weekly and write answers by hand (README.md:25).

LRN-08.evidence: The product produces no learned or AI-made changes and nothing would check one; checks on human edits are scored under DEL-05.

LRN-09.evidence: No post-change measurement; failed lookups carry only a timestamp, so before-and-after comparison is ad hoc.
LRN-09.alt_note: Failed-lookup records are relevant telemetry, though not bound to a version or decision.

LRN-10.evidence: Checks are fixed in desk/checks.py and change only when engineers edit code.

GOV-01.evidence: No component kit or accessibility scans; raw admin HTML (desk/templates/admin.html).

GOV-02.evidence: Definition versions record author and note (desk/store.py:19-31) per answer and rule key; settings changes and user creation are not recorded (desk/app.py:105-112, deskctl.py:35-39); no audit view beyond per-key history.
GOV-02.alt_note: definition_versions acts as a generic change store for definitions with author.

GOV-03.evidence: Customer questions are kept with no classification, export, erasure or retention (desk/store.py:41-51).

GOV-04.evidence: Simple role model (agent/lead) checked on every admin route (desk/app.py:28-36, migrations/001_init.sql:3), validation on definitions (desk/checks.py); pip-audit on every PR (ci.yml:16) but no SAST and no evidence it is a required check; authorisation not generated per type.

GOV-05.evidence: Answers and rules are versioned with history and undo (desk/store.py:19-38, desk/app.py:73-85, tests/test_versions.py:4-9); settings are overwritten with no version (desk/app.py:105-112), and a first version cannot be undone (desk/store.py:36-37).

GOV-06.evidence: Changes go live on save (desk/templates/admin.html:5); no proposal or review object; rule preview only through the try API (desk/app.py:88-96).

GOV-07.evidence: Every change is made by a person; no policy object.

GOV-08.evidence: Definitions are JSON bodies with no contract version (desk/store.py:16); nothing re-checks saved rules when queues.yaml changes at a release (desk/checks.py:41-42 runs only on save).
GOV-08.alt_note: Definitions are data in a stable table and survive releases without code migration in practice.

GOV-09.evidence: Per-user tokens (deskctl.py:35-39, desk/app.py:28-36) and author on definition versions; no dry-run for answers or settings (rule try only, desk/app.py:88-96), no rate limits or idempotency, settings unaudited.

GOV-10.rationale: agent_mutations and evolution_auto_apply are false: no AI or self-change.

GOV-11.rationale: agent_mutations and evolution_auto_apply are false: inputs never drive automatic change.
